I_MV281GWMBE9QEB_YTC556F6I574U1.name: accept pilot program rules
I_MV281GWMBE9QEB_YTC556F6I574U1.desc: The EcoCommute system shall accept pilot program rules, including the minimum aggregate group size, from the Pilot Administrator.
I_MV281GWMBE9QEB_YTC556F6I574U1.Rationale:
Rationale: Reporting rules, such as small-group suppression, are set by the program owner and must govern every summary.
MOP: Share of rule changes in force for the next summary (target 100%).
Verification criteria: Change the minimum group size and confirm the next summary applies it. Method: Demonstration.
Stakeholder requirements: 2.2.3, 2.2.2

I_A25MHFQXPA6DE_6T4QYYG2VSEX.name: exclude infeasible modes
I_A25MHFQXPA6DE_6T4QYYG2VSEX.desc: The EcoCommute system shall exclude from its recommendations every travel mode that the Commuter has marked as not feasible.
I_A25MHFQXPA6DE_6T4QYYG2VSEX.Rationale:
Rationale: Prevents advice the Commuter has already ruled out, such as cycling with equipment or when carrying children.
MOE: Number of recommendations that include a mode marked not feasible (target 0)
MOE selection: A zero-defect count shows directly whether the Commuter's own limits are respected.
Validation: Rule test set covering every combination of marked-not-feasible modes; pass if no recommendation contains an excluded mode.
Verification method: Test
Source needs: 1.1.4 (BMA N4)

I_T6CC17A2QJJ6P9_U0WHTOI0BTYIHZ.name: accept hosting service status
I_T6CC17A2QJJ6P9_U0WHTOI0BTYIHZ.desc: The EcoCommute system shall accept hosting service status from the Hosting Provider.
I_T6CC17A2QJJ6P9_U0WHTOI0BTYIHZ.Rationale:
Rationale: Availability cannot be measured or managed without hosting status.
MOP: Share of status messages recorded (target 100%).
Verification criteria: Replay status messages from a test provider; each is recorded. Method: Test.
Stakeholder requirements: 2.2.4

I_N28WMF9HK4M5_7ZJDCNV35WN.name: recommend a feasible lower-emission option
I_N28WMF9HK4M5_7ZJDCNV35WN.desc: The EcoCommute system shall provide, for each accepted trip with an eligible lower-emission option, one alternative travel mode with a stated reason based on trip distance, forecast weather and the Commuter's feasibility settings.
I_N28WMF9HK4M5_7ZJDCNV35WN.Rationale:
Rationale: Advice only changes behaviour if it fits the Commuter's situation; a stated reason lets the Commuter judge it.
MOE: Percentage of surveyed Commuters who rate the advice feasible (target 80% or more)
MOE selection: Feasibility as perceived by the Commuter is the outcome the stakeholder cares about; rule firing counts would not show it.
Validation: Post-result survey in the pilot; report opt-outs and non-response; rule review against the product description rule (distance under 3 km and no rain).
Verification method: Demonstration
Source needs: 1.1.4 (BMA N4)

I_V99BLJ577YSFI5_TI6HXA369HM59L.name: Output Requirements
I_V99BLJ577YSFI5_TI6HXA369HM59L.desc: Requirements for what the EcoCommute system provides.
I_V99BLJ577YSFI5_TI6HXA369HM59L.Rationale: Rationale: Organizing group for system requirements. Traced to stakeholder requirements 2.

I_ZPJ2XW4CTJZJ_53WEQ4GW1FV.name: calculate a declared baseline
I_ZPJ2XW4CTJZJ_53WEQ4GW1FV.desc: The EcoCommute system shall calculate the always-drive baseline from the trip distance, a declared vehicle emission factor and a declared occupancy.
I_ZPJ2XW4CTJZJ_53WEQ4GW1FV.Rationale:
Rationale: A baseline is fair only if its assumptions are stated and applied consistently.
MOE: Percentage of audited trips whose baseline matches the declared assumptions (target 100%)
MOE selection: A fidelity check shows whether the baseline does what it claims.
Validation: Recalculate the baseline for a sample of 50 trips and compare with system output.
Verification method: Analysis
Source needs: 1.4.2 (BMA N6)

I_XVG7U9O0RG3VDI_7YQE2G2OV7EGWB.name: accept aggregate summary requests
I_XVG7U9O0RG3VDI_7YQE2G2OV7EGWB.desc: The EcoCommute system shall accept aggregate summary requests from the Pilot Administrator.
I_XVG7U9O0RG3VDI_7YQE2G2OV7EGWB.Rationale:
Rationale: The sponsor needs participation evidence on request for a selected period (need 1.2.1).
MOP: Share of authorized requests accepted (target 100%); unauthorized requests rejected (target 100%).
Verification criteria: Submit authorized and unauthorized requests; only authorized ones are accepted. Method: Test.
Stakeholder requirements: 2.2.1

I_L18KCCLCX4RMFT_2CIQK0AZLAJI77.name: utilize authenticated dashboard to interface with the Pilot Administrator
I_L18KCCLCX4RMFT_2CIQK0AZLAJI77.desc: The EcoCommute system shall utilize an authenticated dashboard to interface with the Pilot Administrator.
I_L18KCCLCX4RMFT_2CIQK0AZLAJI77.Rationale:
Rationale: Conduit 'Summary request' is the only path for its information; fixing the medium early lets interface testing start.
MOP: Share of interface exchanges completed through the stated medium (target 100%).
Verification criteria: Exercise the 'Summary request' conduit end to end with a stub of the external party. Method: Test.
Stakeholder requirements: 2.2.1

I_X1NWMVUMS25IHW_FSSIYIJF7HZ8CQ.name: Usability and Accessibility
I_X1NWMVUMS25IHW_FSSIYIJF7HZ8CQ.Rationale: Rationale: Organizing group for system requirements. Traced to stakeholder requirements 2.1, 2.5.

I_G8CQCAPMDAK9YG_WEX95DB4LTBK9X.name: provide commute result and advice to the Commuter
I_G8CQCAPMDAK9YG_WEX95DB4LTBK9X.desc: The EcoCommute system shall provide the commute result and advice to the Commuter.
I_G8CQCAPMDAK9YG_WEX95DB4LTBK9X.Rationale:
Rationale: This is the main value delivered to the Commuter: impact, baseline difference, method, trends, one alternative and an explanation, labeled as estimates.
MOP: Share of accepted trips for which a result is displayed (target 100%).
Verification criteria: Run the end-to-end commute scenario for each supported mode; a complete result appears each time. Method: Test.
Stakeholder requirements: 2.1.2, 2.1.3, 2.1.4, 2.1.6, 2.1.10, 2.4.4

I_5304YRFXZ0FPT_F7SVBGSF6WAY.name: stay within the baseline cost
I_5304YRFXZ0FPT_F7SVBGSF6WAY.desc: The EcoCommute system shall cost no more than $750,000 to develop and deploy.
I_5304YRFXZ0FPT_F7SVBGSF6WAY.Rationale:
Rationale: The baseline budget in the project charter limits the investment the Company Sponsor has approved.
MOE: Cost variance against the $750,000 baseline (target 0% or less)
MOE selection: Variance from the approved baseline is what the sponsor tracks at each gate.
Validation: Sponsor reviews cost forecast, scope variance and evidence at each stage gate.
Verification method: Analysis
Source needs: 1.3.1 (BMA N10)

I_N46P1CNWV6PC_4G41RK2ZZ58.name: conform to accessibility standard
I_N46P1CNWV6PC_4G41RK2ZZ58.desc: The EcoCommute system shall conform to WCAG 2.2 Level AA for the commute entry and result views.
I_N46P1CNWV6PC_4G41RK2ZZ58.Rationale:
Rationale: Inclusive access is a charter expectation and a pilot-entry condition.
MOE: Number of unresolved WCAG 2.2 Level AA failures in the entry and result views (target 0)
MOE selection: Standard conformance gives an externally recognised, countable result.
Validation: Accessibility audit of both views plus keyboard and assistive-technology tasks; pass if no failures remain open.
Verification method: Inspection
Source needs: 1.1.7, 1.5.3 (BMA N8)

I_0ANN0UW9F8UXCM_8OE2EGU38AXI7K.name: suppress aggregate groups below 5 Commuters
I_0ANN0UW9F8UXCM_8OE2EGU38AXI7K.desc: The EcoCommute system shall suppress any aggregate group that contains fewer than 5 Commuters.
I_0ANN0UW9F8UXCM_8OE2EGU38AXI7K.Rationale:
Rationale: Small groups can be re-identified; 5 is a proposed default for the sponsor to confirm.
MOS: Reported groups with fewer than 5 Commuters (threshold 0).
Verification criteria: Aggregation test with seeded group sizes 1 to 10. Method: Test.
Stakeholder requirements: 2.2.3

I_5RR4XT21R0XSC5_A84UEO8C63LNWX.name: report pilot results before June 30, 2027
I_5RR4XT21R0XSC5_A84UEO8C63LNWX.desc: The EcoCommute system shall provide the Company Sponsor with pilot results for each stakeholder measure of effectiveness before June 30, 2027.
I_5RR4XT21R0XSC5_A84UEO8C63LNWX.Rationale:
Rationale: The launch decision needs measured evidence by that date (need 1.3.2).
MOS: Date pilot results delivered (threshold June 30, 2027).
Verification criteria: Compare delivery date with the deadline. Method: Inspection.
Stakeholder requirements: 2.3.4

I_028ZRSZRYJ6MN_ZK7NBDGXH44.name: store only coarse location
I_028ZRSZRYJ6MN_ZK7NBDGXH44.desc: The EcoCommute system shall store trip location only at coarse-area granularity.
I_028ZRSZRYJ6MN_ZK7NBDGXH44.Rationale:
Rationale: Precise coordinates are unnecessary for the product and increase harm if records leak.
MOE: Number of stored records that contain precise coordinates (target 0)
MOE selection: A zero count shows that minimisation is working.
Validation: Database inspection on the pilot build and a field-level data review.
Verification method: Inspection
Source needs: 1.5.1 (BMA N7)

I_ZETDUFHDEPLOZW_PJIO4BSJI0770Q.name: present commute results
I_ZETDUFHDEPLOZW_PJIO4BSJI0770Q.desc: The EcoCommute system shall present commute results.
I_ZETDUFHDEPLOZW_PJIO4BSJI0770Q.Rationale:
Rationale: A result the Commuter cannot read or trust has no value.
MOP: Time from submission to display (target 3 s or less); explanations with unsupported facts (target 0).
Verification criteria: Timing on three reference devices; inspect 50 explanations. Method: Test and Inspection.
Stakeholder requirements: 2.1.2, 2.1.3, 2.1.6, 2.1.9, 2.1.10, 2.4.4

I_80F7KS634KFNIV_CE28UA5EJ5W5FF.name: reproduce reference-case results to the nearest gram
I_80F7KS634KFNIV_CE28UA5EJ5W5FF.desc: The EcoCommute system shall reproduce each agreed reference-case CO2e result to the nearest gram.
I_80F7KS634KFNIV_CE28UA5EJ5W5FF.Rationale:
Rationale: Method reviewers must be able to defend every number.
MOS: Difference from agreed reference value in grams (threshold 0 g).
Verification criteria: Run every agreed reference case. Method: Test.
Stakeholder requirements: 2.4.2

I_HU98P74PVYRXCD_E9EFQ8HHT13NJ0.name: estimate commute emissions
I_HU98P74PVYRXCD_E9EFQ8HHT13NJ0.desc: The EcoCommute system shall estimate commute emissions.
I_HU98P74PVYRXCD_E9EFQ8HHT13NJ0.Rationale:
Rationale: The estimate and always-drive baseline are the core of the product and of method credibility.
MOP: Difference between reproduced and agreed reference-case CO2e (target 0 g after rounding).
Verification criteria: Run all agreed reference cases. Method: Test.
Stakeholder requirements: 2.1.2, 2.1.3, 2.4.2, 2.4.3, 2.4.4

I_9Q2SJFUO96WJQ3_PO9NFMWW3TMRS5.name: System Requirements
I_9Q2SJFUO96WJQ3_PO9NFMWW3TMRS5.desc: System-level requirements of the EcoCommute system, derived from the first-level functional architecture and traced to the stakeholder requirements (2).
I_9Q2SJFUO96WJQ3_PO9NFMWW3TMRS5.Rationale: Rationale: Organizing group for system requirements. Traced to stakeholder requirements 2.

I_ESPH36VRTG3G2_6G7PWTQVDPC.name: enable fast trip entry
I_ESPH36VRTG3G2_6G7PWTQVDPC.desc: The EcoCommute system shall enable a Commuter to submit a commute log entry in 30 seconds or less for at least 80 percent of timed entry tasks.
I_ESPH36VRTG3G2_6G7PWTQVDPC.Rationale:
Rationale: Entry effort is the main barrier to repeated self-reporting; the target is the existing product target in the BMA (80% under 30 seconds).
MOE: Percentage of timed entry tasks completed in 30 seconds or less (target 80% or more)
MOE selection: It measures the effort the Commuter actually experiences, which is an effectiveness measure; internal response time would only measure the system.
Validation: Pilot usability session: at least 20 participants each log five trips on their own device; time from entry form ready to entry accepted; pass if 80% or more of tasks take 30 seconds or less.
Verification method: Test
Source needs: 1.1.1 (BMA N1)

I_0Z4VZ63BDEPS_80SPZ20X2K6K.name: operate with the pilot cohort
I_0Z4VZ63BDEPS_80SPZ20X2K6K.desc: The EcoCommute system shall operate without functional failure with at least 500 enrolled Commuter accounts.
I_0Z4VZ63BDEPS_80SPZ20X2K6K.Rationale:
Rationale: 500 enrolled users is the existing pilot participation target in the BMA and must be technically possible.
MOE: Number of enrolled Commuter accounts with which the system operates without functional failure (target 500 or more)
MOE selection: Cohort size is the sponsor's direct indicator of pilot scale.
Validation: Create 500 test accounts and run the entry and summary tasks; pass if no functional failures occur.
Verification method: Test
Source needs: 1.3.2 (BMA N2)

I_NAQWDJSQN6ME_H6XN38RG4W6W.name: delete trip records on request
I_NAQWDJSQN6ME_H6XN38RG4W6W.desc: The EcoCommute system shall permanently delete all of a Commuter's trip records upon the Commuter's deletion request.
I_NAQWDJSQN6ME_H6XN38RG4W6W.Rationale:
Rationale: Control over one's own data builds the trust needed for voluntary participation.
MOE: Percentage of deletion requests that leave no identifiable trip record (target 100%)
MOE selection: Completeness of deletion is what the Commuter can rely on; it is objectively countable.
Validation: Deletion test: create records for test accounts, request deletion, query storage and backups in scope; pass if none remain.
Verification method: Test
Source needs: 1.1.6 (BMA N7)

I_8W84DRZZQ052Q_63F8SY8WKCGT.name: record consent before storing trips
I_8W84DRZZQ052Q_63F8SY8WKCGT.desc: The EcoCommute system shall require a recorded Commuter consent before storing the first trip record.
I_8W84DRZZQ052Q_63F8SY8WKCGT.Rationale:
Rationale: Shows that participation is voluntary and informed.
MOE: Number of stored trip records without prior recorded consent (target 0)
MOE selection: A count of exceptions is what the assurance reviewers need for sign-off.
Validation: Test flow: attempt to store a trip without consent and with consent; audit stored records against the consent log.
Verification method: Test
Source needs: 1.5.2 (BMA N7)

I_UNVEIG4TJ577HZ_CCGAEKWDTG9WQV.name: manage reference data
I_UNVEIG4TJ577HZ_CCGAEKWDTG9WQV.desc: The EcoCommute system shall manage reference data.
I_UNVEIG4TJ577HZ_CCGAEKWDTG9WQV.Rationale:
Rationale: Estimates and advice are only as good as the factor and forecast behind them.
MOP: Share of estimates using a reviewed factor with provenance (target 100%).
Verification criteria: Inspect factor records used by a sample of estimates. Method: Inspection.
Stakeholder requirements: 2.4.1, 2.1.4, 2.5.1

I_A9CFPT5VGPNB_6CZWCDEWY0T4.name: record accepted-log events
I_A9CFPT5VGPNB_6CZWCDEWY0T4.desc: The EcoCommute system shall record a timestamped event for every accepted trip log so that weekly active use can be computed for each enrolled Commuter.
I_A9CFPT5VGPNB_6CZWCDEWY0T4.Rationale:
Rationale: The launch decision depends on engagement evidence, which can only be computed if usage events are recorded.
MOE: Percentage of enrolled Commuters whose weekly active status can be computed from recorded events (target 100%)
MOE selection: Completeness of the evidence base is what the sponsor needs before relying on the engagement figure.
Validation: Reconcile the event log with accepted entries for test accounts; pass if every accepted entry has exactly one event.
Verification method: Test
Source needs: 1.3.2 (BMA N2, N10)

I_JW9HQDSS8TSBG_R01T25FXJHQ.name: suppress small groups
I_JW9HQDSS8TSBG_R01T25FXJHQ.desc: The EcoCommute system shall suppress any aggregate group that contains fewer than 5 Commuters.
I_JW9HQDSS8TSBG_R01T25FXJHQ.Rationale:
Rationale: Small groups can be re-identified from aggregates. The value 5 is a proposed default because the BMA leaves the threshold open; the pilot sponsor must confirm it.
MOE: Number of reported groups with fewer than 5 Commuters (target 0)
MOE selection: It converts re-identification risk into a countable, testable measure.
Validation: Aggregation test with seeded groups of sizes 1 to 10; pass if no group below the threshold is reported; sponsor confirms threshold.
Verification method: Test
Source needs: 1.2.2 (BMA N7)

I_0K1Z7IMT5I96HZ_J6GHL5LC8E42UQ.name: Privacy and Security
I_0K1Z7IMT5I96HZ_J6GHL5LC8E42UQ.Rationale: Rationale: Organizing group for system requirements. Traced to stakeholder requirements 2.1, 2.2, 2.5.

I_9MDN486YK9Z7_22604AP3K6PG.name: use reviewed emission factors
I_9MDN486YK9Z7_22604AP3K6PG.desc: The EcoCommute system shall calculate trip CO2e using only reviewed emission factors that record source, units, geography and version.
I_9MDN486YK9Z7_22604AP3K6PG.Rationale:
Rationale: Traceable factors make results defensible and allow later review.
MOE: Percentage of calculated trips whose factor record is complete (target 100%)
MOE selection: Provenance completeness is what the Method Reviewer needs to defend a number.
Validation: Audit of factor store and a sample of calculated trips; confirm source, units, geography and version are present.
Verification method: Inspection
Source needs: 1.4.1 (BMA N6)

I_YMVK22V0WG99F_TP7KE8T1KR87.name: Pilot Sponsor and Administrator Requirements
I_YMVK22V0WG99F_TP7KE8T1KR87.desc: Stakeholder requirements derived from the needs of Institutional Pilot Sponsor and Administrator (SH.2).

I_OC8NB8DV41MLEA_JKPDGI8OT0CXOJ.name: display each trip result within 3 seconds
I_OC8NB8DV41MLEA_JKPDGI8OT0CXOJ.desc: The EcoCommute system shall display each trip result within 3 seconds of entry submission.
I_OC8NB8DV41MLEA_JKPDGI8OT0CXOJ.Rationale:
Rationale: Immediate feedback is the core value proposition; 3 s is a proposed threshold to confirm with the sponsor.
MOS: Time from submission to result display in seconds (threshold 3 s).
Verification criteria: Timing test on three reference devices. Method: Test.
Stakeholder requirements: 2.1.2

I_JS5KD1CHF81T_5SCQJZHHYQKW.name: pass assistive-technology walkthrough
I_JS5KD1CHF81T_5SCQJZHHYQKW.desc: The EcoCommute system shall allow a keyboard-only user and a screen-reader user to complete the commute entry task before pilot readiness.
I_JS5KD1CHF81T_5SCQJZHHYQKW.Rationale:
Rationale: Verifies accessibility with real tasks before real users are enrolled.
MOE: Number of unresolved critical task barriers for keyboard and screen-reader users (target 0)
MOE selection: Task completion shows whether conformance on paper translates into real access.
Validation: Moderated walkthrough with at least one keyboard-only and one screen-reader user; barriers logged and resolved.
Verification method: Demonstration
Source needs: 1.5.3 (BMA N8)

I_P71Z779MFY46ZP_MUDQOJ0B0G6PLE.name: evaluate feasible alternatives
I_P71Z779MFY46ZP_MUDQOJ0B0G6PLE.desc: The EcoCommute system shall evaluate feasible alternatives.
I_P71Z779MFY46ZP_MUDQOJ0B0G6PLE.Rationale:
Rationale: Advice that ignores weather or the Commuter's limits will not be followed.
MOP: Recommendations containing a mode marked not feasible (target 0).
Verification criteria: Rule test set over all combinations of excluded modes. Method: Test.
Stakeholder requirements: 2.1.4, 2.1.5

I_6EUVVS2JRXNZ7Z_I0ZLQNYAB0CFP3.name: provide approved aggregate summaries to the Pilot Administrator
I_6EUVVS2JRXNZ7Z_I0ZLQNYAB0CFP3.desc: The EcoCommute system shall provide approved aggregate summaries to the Pilot Administrator.
I_6EUVVS2JRXNZ7Z_I0ZLQNYAB0CFP3.Rationale:
Rationale: Institutions receive program-level evidence only, also exported at retirement.
MOP: Share of authorized requests answered with the three required figures (target 100%).
Verification criteria: Request a summary for a seeded cohort and compare figures with known totals. Method: Demonstration.
Stakeholder requirements: 2.2.1, 2.2.2, 2.3.7

I_FLVQ06TA6CI5YZ_5Y4SGUVP5THVL9.name: summarize pilot results
I_FLVQ06TA6CI5YZ_5Y4SGUVP5THVL9.desc: The EcoCommute system shall summarize pilot results.
I_FLVQ06TA6CI5YZ_5Y4SGUVP5THVL9.Rationale:
Rationale: Sponsors need evidence without exposing individuals.
MOP: Groups reported with fewer than 5 Commuters (target 0); individual identifiers in summaries (target 0).
Verification criteria: Aggregation test with seeded groups of 1 to 10. Method: Test.
Stakeholder requirements: 2.2.1, 2.2.2, 2.2.3, 2.3.4, 2.3.7

I_VI8HMC45MLUKGL_2I88G8FVBIF64H.name: provide weather requests to Open-Meteo
I_VI8HMC45MLUKGL_2I88G8FVBIF64H.desc: The EcoCommute system shall provide weather requests, containing only a coarse location and trip time, to Open-Meteo.
I_VI8HMC45MLUKGL_2I88G8FVBIF64H.Rationale:
Rationale: Weather lookups must not disclose more location detail than the coarse-area rule allows.
MOP: Number of weather requests containing more than coarse location and time (target 0).
Verification criteria: Capture outbound requests during a test run and inspect their fields. Method: Inspection.
Stakeholder requirements: 2.1.4, 2.5.1

I_16LQZPG2K84OKJ_MPW08F781QWV9L.name: utilize HTTPS API request to interface with Open-Meteo
I_16LQZPG2K84OKJ_MPW08F781QWV9L.desc: The EcoCommute system shall utilize an HTTPS API request to interface with Open-Meteo.
I_16LQZPG2K84OKJ_MPW08F781QWV9L.Rationale:
Rationale: Conduit 'Weather query' is the only path for its information; fixing the medium early lets interface testing start.
MOP: Share of interface exchanges completed through the stated medium (target 100%).
Verification criteria: Exercise the 'Weather query' conduit end to end with a stub of the external party. Method: Test.
Stakeholder requirements: 2.1.4, 2.5.1

I_9VF91LO2QT7STN_HWT6QB722ZTYLK.name: External Interface Requirements
I_9VF91LO2QT7STN_HWT6QB722ZTYLK.desc: Requirements for the conduits between the EcoCommute system and external assets.
I_9VF91LO2QT7STN_HWT6QB722ZTYLK.Rationale: Rationale: Organizing group for system requirements. Traced to stakeholder requirements 2.

I_3BKUR35D5FDAE4_YP35AP98W0YPHZ.name: utilize responsive web result view over HTTPS to interface with the Commuter
I_3BKUR35D5FDAE4_YP35AP98W0YPHZ.desc: The EcoCommute system shall utilize a responsive web result view over HTTPS to interface with the Commuter.
I_3BKUR35D5FDAE4_YP35AP98W0YPHZ.Rationale:
Rationale: Conduit 'Result and advice' is the only path for its information; fixing the medium early lets interface testing start.
MOP: Share of interface exchanges completed through the stated medium (target 100%).
Verification criteria: Exercise the 'Result and advice' conduit end to end with a stub of the external party. Method: Test.
Stakeholder requirements: 2.1.2, 2.1.9

I_62G20FC30AR6P_QZ31YBK1AQN.name: provide participation summary
I_62G20FC30AR6P_QZ31YBK1AQN.desc: The EcoCommute system shall provide an authorized Pilot Administrator with the enrollment count, the weekly active count and the total CO2e for a selected reporting period.
I_62G20FC30AR6P_QZ31YBK1AQN.Rationale:
Rationale: The sponsor needs engagement evidence for its own reporting; these three figures are the minimum the BMA identifies.
MOE: Percentage of the sponsor's reporting questions that the summary answers or explicitly defers (target 100%)
MOE selection: It tests the summary against what the sponsor actually has to report rather than against what the system happens to produce.
Validation: Review the approved summary against the sponsor's list of reporting questions at pilot readiness; record deferrals with sponsor agreement.
Verification method: Demonstration
Source needs: 1.2.1 (BMA N5)

I_MCJWZ87P5JJ8R_957S2GTAVS8.name: display trip impact and baseline difference
I_MCJWZ87P5JJ8R_957S2GTAVS8.desc: The EcoCommute system shall display the estimated CO2e of each accepted trip, in grams, together with its difference from the always-drive baseline within 3 seconds of entry submission.
I_MCJWZ87P5JJ8R_957S2GTAVS8.Rationale:
Rationale: Immediate, connected feedback is the core value proposition. The 3-second limit is a proposed responsiveness threshold to confirm in discovery.
MOE: Percentage of surveyed Commuters who correctly explain the estimate and the baseline difference (target 80% or more)
MOE selection: Comprehension, not mere display, shows whether the feedback is useful to the Commuter.
Validation: Structured comprehension questions after use in the pilot; disclose sample size and scoring; confirm display time with a timing test on three reference devices.
Verification method: Test
Source needs: 1.1.2 (BMA N3)

I_7C2YZCBMA6BW_65N185Y74MN.name: exclude individual data from summaries
I_7C2YZCBMA6BW_65N185Y74MN.desc: The EcoCommute system shall exclude individual Commuter identifiers and trip records from every institutional summary.
I_7C2YZCBMA6BW_65N185Y74MN.Rationale:
Rationale: Institutions should see program-level evidence only, which keeps individual privacy and limits the sponsor's exposure.
MOE: Number of individual identifiers or trip records found in institutional outputs (target 0)
MOE selection: Any single occurrence is a privacy failure, so a zero-count measure is appropriate.
Validation: Output inspection and access tests on every summary type before release.
Verification method: Inspection
Source needs: 1.2.2 (BMA N5, N7)

I_9PKZRN50IUT2KP_PCF9QU9MI6MPDK.name: accept weather forecast data
I_9PKZRN50IUT2KP_PCF9QU9MI6MPDK.desc: The EcoCommute system shall accept weather forecast data from Open-Meteo.
I_9PKZRN50IUT2KP_PCF9QU9MI6MPDK.Rationale:
Rationale: The alternative-mode rule depends on forecast weather for the trip.
MOP: Share of well-formed forecast responses accepted (target 100%).
Verification criteria: Feed recorded well-formed and malformed responses through the interface; well-formed ones are accepted, malformed ones are rejected. Method: Test.
Stakeholder requirements: 2.1.4

I_ZG70EX744QC1ZO_3U29XZ349XG1ZW.name: accept commuter consent and settings
I_ZG70EX744QC1ZO_3U29XZ349XG1ZW.desc: The EcoCommute system shall accept commuter consent and feasibility settings from the Commuter.
I_ZG70EX744QC1ZO_3U29XZ349XG1ZW.Rationale:
Rationale: Consent must be recorded before trips are stored and feasibility settings must reach the rules that choose alternatives.
MOP: Share of consent and settings submissions recorded and applied (target 100%).
Verification criteria: Record consent for a test account, mark one mode not feasible, and confirm both are stored and applied. Method: Test.
Stakeholder requirements: 2.5.2, 2.1.5

I_478MQMV3QZXPF_A636EPX5AXP1.name: maintain service availability
I_478MQMV3QZXPF_A636EPX5AXP1.desc: The EcoCommute system shall maintain an availability of at least 99.5 percent during each month of the pilot.
I_478MQMV3QZXPF_A636EPX5AXP1.Rationale:
Rationale: Reliable access protects the logging habit and the sponsor's credibility; the value is the existing product target.
MOE: Measured monthly availability (target 99.5% or more)
MOE selection: Availability as experienced by users is the usual effectiveness measure for dependable service.
Validation: Define the measurement period and exclusions before the pilot; monitor a successful service check every minute; report monthly.
Verification method: Analysis
Source needs: 1.2.3 (BMA N9)

I_WQSXYQ6VSPFAS_DZT8MKWAFF25.name: display trends and cumulative difference
I_WQSXYQ6VSPFAS_DZT8MKWAFF25.desc: The EcoCommute system shall display each Commuter's weekly and monthly CO2e totals and cumulative CO2e difference from the always-drive baseline.
I_WQSXYQ6VSPFAS_DZT8MKWAFF25.Rationale:
Rationale: Seeing progress over time is what keeps a Commuter logging after the first week.
MOE: Weekly active use after eight weeks (target 40% or more of enrolled Commuters)
MOE selection: Sustained use is the best available proxy for the Commuter finding the trend feedback worthwhile; it is the existing BMA target.
Validation: Cohort report: a Commuter is active if there is at least one accepted log in the preceding seven days; denominator is all enrolled Commuters; measured at week eight.
Verification method: Analysis
Source needs: 1.1.5 (BMA N2)

I_US4GZLDDVCI2UP_JRT7EUFNH5SNMV.name: Estimation Quality
I_US4GZLDDVCI2UP_JRT7EUFNH5SNMV.Rationale: Rationale: Organizing group for system requirements. Traced to stakeholder requirements 2.4.

I_XSSXAH8VV05X_Y2ZD95NRQH83.name: Commuter Requirements
I_XSSXAH8VV05X_Y2ZD95NRQH83.desc: Stakeholder requirements derived from the needs of Commuters (Students and Employees) (SH.1).

I_SY3DO4KAHLW4FR_B98IER2QBXWRBT.name: complete commute entry in 30 seconds or less
I_SY3DO4KAHLW4FR_B98IER2QBXWRBT.desc: The EcoCommute system shall enable a Commuter to complete a commute entry in 30 seconds or less for at least 80 percent of timed entry tasks.
I_SY3DO4KAHLW4FR_B98IER2QBXWRBT.Rationale:
Rationale: Entry effort is the main barrier to repeated use.
MOS: Percentage of timed entry tasks at or under 30 s (threshold 80%).
Verification criteria: Pilot usability session, 20 participants, five trips each. Method: Test.
Stakeholder requirements: 2.1.1

I_34FBESPF98EY_J98TTG5BNGT.name: Assurance Reviewer Requirements
I_34FBESPF98EY_J98TTG5BNGT.desc: Stakeholder requirements derived from the needs of Privacy, Security and Accessibility Reviewers (Assurance) (SH.5).

I_0JTF91DM3VZLU2_0NMV2W0NAGG1O8.name: Cost and Schedule
I_0JTF91DM3VZLU2_0NMV2W0NAGG1O8.Rationale: Rationale: Organizing group for system requirements. Traced to stakeholder requirements 2.3.

I_9ZTA8J061OSYK9_RFZQFJ5UNT9YKJ.name: collect commute entries
I_9ZTA8J061OSYK9_RFZQFJ5UNT9YKJ.desc: The EcoCommute system shall collect commute entries.
I_9ZTA8J061OSYK9_RFZQFJ5UNT9YKJ.Rationale:
Rationale: Entry effort and consent are the first gate to every other function.
MOP: Median time to submit an entry (target 30 s or less for 80% of timed tasks).
Verification criteria: Timed usability session with at least 20 participants. Method: Test.
Stakeholder requirements: 2.1.1, 2.1.9, 2.5.2, 2.5.3

I_4I2T6MQ0OSZFTN_BMRPIB05F9ZMXS.name: cost no more than $750,000 to develop and deploy
I_4I2T6MQ0OSZFTN_BMRPIB05F9ZMXS.desc: The EcoCommute system shall cost no more than $750,000 to develop and deploy.
I_4I2T6MQ0OSZFTN_BMRPIB05F9ZMXS.Rationale:
Rationale: The Company Sponsor approved a $750,000 baseline (need 1.3.1).
MOS: Total development and deployment cost in USD (threshold $750,000).
Verification criteria: Cost report at pilot readiness against the baseline. Method: Analysis.
Stakeholder requirements: 2.3.1

I_KZ87S967BZB2_YWMGMJY6SB3.name: disclose estimation method
I_KZ87S967BZB2_YWMGMJY6SB3.desc: The EcoCommute system shall display, with each trip result, the emission factor source, the factor version and the distance convention used to calculate it.
I_KZ87S967BZB2_YWMGMJY6SB3.Rationale:
Rationale: People trust an estimate only if they can see what it rests on; also supports reviewer traceability.
MOE: Percentage of displayed trip results that carry source, version and distance convention (target 100%)
MOE selection: A completeness count is objective and directly reflects the stakeholder's need to know where numbers come from.
Validation: Inspection of a random sample of 50 displayed results in the pilot build; pass if every sampled result shows all three items.
Verification method: Inspection
Source needs: 1.1.3 (BMA N3, N6)

I_51EYNPLDR8KJAK_8PJK5LIXDAVPQR.name: conform to WCAG 2.2 Level AA
I_51EYNPLDR8KJAK_8PJK5LIXDAVPQR.desc: The EcoCommute system shall conform to WCAG 2.2 Level AA for the commute entry and result views.
I_51EYNPLDR8KJAK_8PJK5LIXDAVPQR.Rationale:
Rationale: Inclusive access is a charter expectation and a pilot-entry condition.
MOS: Unresolved WCAG 2.2 AA failures (threshold 0).
Verification criteria: Accessibility audit plus keyboard-only and screen-reader walkthroughs. Method: Inspection.
Stakeholder requirements: 2.1.9, 2.5.3

I_7364FB07DARL3J_RLAC3W92KCSNF1.name: operate with at least 500 enrolled accounts
I_7364FB07DARL3J_RLAC3W92KCSNF1.desc: The EcoCommute system shall operate without functional failure with at least 500 enrolled Commuter accounts.
I_7364FB07DARL3J_RLAC3W92KCSNF1.Rationale:
Rationale: The pilot cohort is sized at 500 Commuters.
MOS: Functional failures observed at 500 accounts (threshold 0).
Verification criteria: Load test with 500 seeded accounts. Method: Test.
Stakeholder requirements: 2.3.3

I_FVYXRIDWOZWRDG_1Y0QDQCGGQHW20.name: Availability and Capacity
I_FVYXRIDWOZWRDG_1Y0QDQCGGQHW20.Rationale: Rationale: Organizing group for system requirements. Traced to stakeholder requirements 2.2, 2.3.

I_TD6P2Q72S4S3DE_2F4ZHFUJTTZ3DJ.name: Functional Requirements
I_TD6P2Q72S4S3DE_2F4ZHFUJTTZ3DJ.desc: Requirements for the top-level function and its first-level functions.
I_TD6P2Q72S4S3DE_2F4ZHFUJTTZ3DJ.Rationale: Rationale: Organizing group for system requirements. Traced to stakeholder requirements 2.1, 2.2, 2.3, 2.4, 2.5.

I_6I3A6C2P83ZZ3K_RI11A8F304C5NJ.name: Performance
I_6I3A6C2P83ZZ3K_RI11A8F304C5NJ.Rationale: Rationale: Organizing group for system requirements. Traced to stakeholder requirements 2.1.

I_SP1YIJZYPRKW40_HOYYCJVKX29NSZ.name: accept reviewed emission factors
I_SP1YIJZYPRKW40_HOYYCJVKX29NSZ.desc: The EcoCommute system shall accept reviewed emission factors, with source, units, geography and version, from the Emission Factor Publisher.
I_SP1YIJZYPRKW40_HOYYCJVKX29NSZ.Rationale:
Rationale: Only reviewed factors with recorded provenance may be used in estimates (need 1.4.1).
MOP: Share of factor records stored with source, units, geography and version (target 100%).
Verification criteria: Ingest a reviewed factor file; inspect that every stored record carries all four fields. Method: Inspection.
Stakeholder requirements: 2.4.1

I_K3WB6279TY92X5_CSYNQDA4A8DP7C.name: utilize responsive web entry form over HTTPS to interface with the Commuter
I_K3WB6279TY92X5_CSYNQDA4A8DP7C.desc: The EcoCommute system shall utilize a responsive web entry form over HTTPS to interface with the Commuter.
I_K3WB6279TY92X5_CSYNQDA4A8DP7C.Rationale:
Rationale: Conduit 'Trip details' is the only path for its information; fixing the medium early lets interface testing start.
MOP: Share of interface exchanges completed through the stated medium (target 100%).
Verification criteria: Exercise the 'Trip details' conduit end to end with a stub of the external party. Method: Test.
Stakeholder requirements: 2.1.1, 2.1.9

I_XG6VSDYH0KS0U5_5JAOR0HI34UM8N.name: utilize authenticated dashboard and approved aggregate export to interface with the Pilot Administrator
I_XG6VSDYH0KS0U5_5JAOR0HI34UM8N.desc: The EcoCommute system shall utilize an authenticated dashboard and approved aggregate export to interface with the Pilot Administrator.
I_XG6VSDYH0KS0U5_5JAOR0HI34UM8N.Rationale:
Rationale: Conduit 'Approved aggregates' is the only path for its information; fixing the medium early lets interface testing start.
MOP: Share of interface exchanges completed through the stated medium (target 100%).
Verification criteria: Exercise the 'Approved aggregates' conduit end to end with a stub of the external party. Method: Test.
Stakeholder requirements: 2.2.1, 2.3.7

I_C5RYSFCM3GE9T_T6FB4S4K3M5.name: label differences as estimates
I_C5RYSFCM3GE9T_T6FB4S4K3M5.desc: The EcoCommute system shall label each baseline difference as an estimated difference.
I_C5RYSFCM3GE9T_T6FB4S4K3M5.Rationale:
Rationale: The difference is a modeled counterfactual, not verified avoided emissions.
MOE: Percentage of displayed baseline differences labelled as estimated (target 100%)
MOE selection: A labelling count shows whether the product avoids overclaiming.
Validation: Inspection of all views that show a baseline difference.
Verification method: Inspection
Source needs: 1.4.3 (BMA N6)

I_R1ZU38W5U29COK_1OSDZYRJI1Q06O.name: maintain availability of at least 99.5 percent
I_R1ZU38W5U29COK_1OSDZYRJI1Q06O.desc: The EcoCommute system shall maintain an availability of at least 99.5 percent during each month of the pilot.
I_R1ZU38W5U29COK_1OSDZYRJI1Q06O.Rationale:
Rationale: Reliable access protects the logging habit and the sponsor's credibility.
MOS: Measured monthly availability (threshold 99.5%).
Verification criteria: Monitor a successful service check every minute and report monthly. Method: Analysis.
Stakeholder requirements: 2.2.4

I_XX7H9W0TVBVA_2B2QYHC5KW2.name: report pilot results
I_XX7H9W0TVBVA_2B2QYHC5KW2.desc: The EcoCommute system shall provide the Company Sponsor with pilot results for each stakeholder measure of effectiveness before June 30, 2027.
I_XX7H9W0TVBVA_2B2QYHC5KW2.Rationale:
Rationale: The launch decision is scheduled for June 30, 2027 and needs evidence first.
MOE: Number of measures of effectiveness with reported pilot results at the decision date (target equal to the number defined)
MOE selection: It checks that the evidence the sponsor needs actually arrives in time.
Validation: Evaluation report checked against the MOE list at the launch-decision gate.
Verification method: Inspection
Source needs: 1.3.2 (BMA N10)

I_91B2ZPU4EE7X2A_5APVQQEQM09SIF.name: restrict access to individual trip records
I_91B2ZPU4EE7X2A_5APVQQEQM09SIF.desc: The EcoCommute system shall restrict access to each Commuter's individual trip records to that Commuter.
I_91B2ZPU4EE7X2A_5APVQQEQM09SIF.Rationale:
Rationale: Privacy control is a condition of voluntary participation.
MOS: Individual records exposed to any other role (threshold 0).
Verification criteria: Role-based access test matrix. Method: Test.
Stakeholder requirements: 2.1.7

I_MWF61HV1748J6D_NERSU4PSQRD3DT.name: provide commute impact decision support
I_MWF61HV1748J6D_NERSU4PSQRD3DT.desc: The EcoCommute system shall provide commute impact decision support.
I_MWF61HV1748J6D_NERSU4PSQRD3DT.Rationale:
Rationale: Single top-level functional requirement. It is the highest-level action that delivers the stakeholder value: help commuters interpret impact and consider practical lower-carbon options, and give institutions approved engagement information.
MOP: Share of nominal-scenario trips (UC.1) that end with an estimate, baseline difference and, where eligible, one alternative displayed (target 100%).
Verification criteria: Execute the UC.1 scenario for the reference cases and inspect each result. Method: Test.
Stakeholder requirements: 2.1.2, 2.1.4, 2.2.1, 2.3.2, 2.4.1, 2.5.2

I_QT3GENA8L3HTY3_1L89Q6IJS78TPU.name: Input Requirements
I_QT3GENA8L3HTY3_1L89Q6IJS78TPU.desc: Requirements for what the EcoCommute system accepts.
I_QT3GENA8L3HTY3_1L89Q6IJS78TPU.Rationale: Rationale: Organizing group for system requirements. Traced to stakeholder requirements 2.

I_7MFYFNRHQ2344_G77KVXD9TD9.name: reproduce reference cases
I_7MFYFNRHQ2344_G77KVXD9TD9.desc: The EcoCommute system shall reproduce each agreed reference-case CO2e result to the nearest gram.
I_7MFYFNRHQ2344_G77KVXD9TD9.Rationale:
Rationale: Reference cases give an independent check on the calculation, including units and occupancy handling.
MOE: Percentage of agreed reference cases reproduced (target 100%)
MOE selection: It compares the system with calculations the reviewers made independently.
Validation: Reviewers calculate the reference cases independently and compare with system output.
Verification method: Test
Source needs: 1.4.1 (BMA N6)

I_NQ38REERI2IENY_575XAFCXXGDPIZ.name: operate service
I_NQ38REERI2IENY_575XAFCXXGDPIZ.Rationale:
Rationale: Reliable operation and clean retirement are conditions of the pilot.
MOP: Monthly availability (target 99.5% or more); identifiable records left at retirement (target 0).
Verification criteria: Monitor availability; retirement rehearsal. Method: Analysis and Test.
Stakeholder requirements: 2.2.4, 2.3.3, 2.3.6, 2.3.7

I_HT78XYMCDTK9_5R7M97W8FKQ.name: delete identifiable records at retirement
I_HT78XYMCDTK9_5R7M97W8FKQ.desc: The EcoCommute system shall permanently delete all identifiable Commuter records at service retirement.
I_HT78XYMCDTK9_5R7M97W8FKQ.Rationale:
Rationale: Prevents the company from carrying personal data after the program ends.
MOE: Percentage of identifiable Commuter records deleted at retirement (target 100%)
MOE selection: Completeness of deletion is the sponsor's liability measure.
Validation: Disposal rehearsal on a copy of the pilot data before retirement; sponsor-approved retention review.
Verification method: Test
Source needs: 1.3.4 (BMA N12)

I_07TJBFYHUJH28I_PTX20NHOG9VL6R.name: utilize provider deployment and status interface to interface with the Hosting Provider
I_07TJBFYHUJH28I_PTX20NHOG9VL6R.desc: The EcoCommute system shall utilize a provider deployment and status interface to interface with the Hosting Provider.
I_07TJBFYHUJH28I_PTX20NHOG9VL6R.Rationale:
Rationale: Conduit 'Hosting service' is the only path for its information; fixing the medium early lets interface testing start.
MOP: Share of interface exchanges completed through the stated medium (target 100%).
Verification criteria: Exercise the 'Hosting service' conduit end to end with a stub of the external party. Method: Test.
Stakeholder requirements: 2.2.4

I_70PI83XCIB869R_QH243DVHKDAW70.name: store only coarse location and collect no device traces
I_70PI83XCIB869R_QH243DVHKDAW70.desc: The EcoCommute system shall store trip location only at coarse-area granularity and shall not collect location traces from Commuter devices.
I_70PI83XCIB869R_QH243DVHKDAW70.Rationale:
Rationale: Data minimisation limits the harm of a leaked record and the sponsor's privacy exposure.
MOS: Stored location fields finer than coarse area (threshold 0); device traces collected (threshold 0).
Verification criteria: Inspect the data model and a sample of stored records. Method: Inspection.
Stakeholder requirements: 2.5.1, 2.3.5

I_91DF7299VWKCFU_9RPX73WKG78N6O.name: accept commuter entries and requests
I_91DF7299VWKCFU_9RPX73WKG78N6O.desc: The EcoCommute system shall accept commuter entries and requests from the Commuter, including trip mode, distance, date, occupancy where applicable, coarse area and record deletion requests.
I_91DF7299VWKCFU_9RPX73WKG78N6O.Rationale:
Rationale: A commute can only be logged, and data control exercised, if the system accepts these items from the Commuter (need 1.1.1, 1.1.6).
MOP: Share of valid, supported entries accepted (target 100%).
Verification criteria: Submit a set of valid entries covering every supported mode and one deletion request; each is accepted. Method: Test.
Stakeholder requirements: 2.1.1, 2.1.8

I_O3WPJN1LWC1TM9_YIQZ3GJ7HZ17KY.name: Input/Output Requirements
I_O3WPJN1LWC1TM9_YIQZ3GJ7HZ17KY.desc: Requirements for the inputs, controls and outputs of the top-level function F.2 Provide Commute Impact Decision Support.
I_O3WPJN1LWC1TM9_YIQZ3GJ7HZ17KY.Rationale: Rationale: Organizing group for system requirements. Traced to stakeholder requirements 2.

I_NJO5WS7C32EM0S_5S6CFD82OXEQ2B.name: manage commute records
I_NJO5WS7C32EM0S_5S6CFD82OXEQ2B.desc: The EcoCommute system shall manage commute records.
I_NJO5WS7C32EM0S_5S6CFD82OXEQ2B.Rationale:
Rationale: Records feed trends, evidence and pilot results while protecting privacy.
MOP: Trip records exposed to other roles (target 0); deletion requests leaving a record (target 0).
Verification criteria: Role-based access matrix and deletion test. Method: Test.
Stakeholder requirements: 2.1.6, 2.1.7, 2.1.8, 2.3.2, 2.3.5, 2.3.6, 2.5.1, 2.5.2

I_SR9X0E7HIUXU1D_X53WPVKGDGOW3F.name: provide release configuration to the Hosting Provider
I_SR9X0E7HIUXU1D_X53WPVKGDGOW3F.desc: The EcoCommute system shall provide release configuration to the Hosting Provider.
I_SR9X0E7HIUXU1D_X53WPVKGDGOW3F.Rationale:
Rationale: The service can be deployed and operated only if the provider receives the release configuration.
MOP: Share of releases deployable from the supplied configuration without manual change (target 100%).
Verification criteria: Deploy a release to a test environment using only the supplied configuration. Method: Demonstration.
Stakeholder requirements: 2.2.4

I_MC8CF3AJFVR89_RFHAPYT7ERR2.name: restrict access to individual trip records
I_MC8CF3AJFVR89_RFHAPYT7ERR2.desc: The EcoCommute system shall restrict access to each Commuter's individual trip records to that Commuter.
I_MC8CF3AJFVR89_RFHAPYT7ERR2.Rationale:
Rationale: Privacy control is a condition of participation for Commuters and a legal and reputational risk for the sponsors.
MOE: Number of individual trip records exposed to any other role in access tests (target 0)
MOE selection: A single exposure defeats the purpose, so the measure is a count that must stay at zero.
Validation: Role-based access test matrix across Commuter, Pilot Administrator and company staff roles; residual privacy-risk review by the assurance reviewers.
Verification method: Test
Source needs: 1.1.6, 1.2.2 (BMA N7)

I_KRWQZ2JRDG30Y_3F2X1AMHXZ3.name: Company Sponsor Requirements
I_KRWQZ2JRDG30Y_3F2X1AMHXZ3.desc: Stakeholder requirements derived from the needs of Company Sponsor and Leadership (SH.3).

I_H3X3KSK09TVEJ_AH5SG59ZMDKR.name: Method Reviewer Requirements
I_H3X3KSK09TVEJ_AH5SG59ZMDKR.desc: Stakeholder requirements derived from the needs of Sustainability and Transportation Staff (Method Reviewers) (SH.4).

I_8WGM52MNO24A70_EFA57E15G6DLNO.name: utilize structured HTTPS API response to interface with Open-Meteo
I_8WGM52MNO24A70_EFA57E15G6DLNO.desc: The EcoCommute system shall utilize a structured HTTPS API response to interface with Open-Meteo.
I_8WGM52MNO24A70_EFA57E15G6DLNO.Rationale:
Rationale: Conduit 'Forecast' is the only path for its information; fixing the medium early lets interface testing start.
MOP: Share of interface exchanges completed through the stated medium (target 100%).
Verification criteria: Exercise the 'Forecast' conduit end to end with a stub of the external party. Method: Test.
Stakeholder requirements: 2.1.4

I_0VNNUXB0S0JP9_7KM8O5GKCMJ8.name: explain result from calculated facts
I_0VNNUXB0S0JP9_7KM8O5GKCMJ8.desc: The EcoCommute system shall display with each trip result a plain-language explanation that states only facts contained in the calculated result: the estimated CO2e, the baseline difference, the factor source and version, and the recommendation reason.
I_0VNNUXB0S0JP9_7KM8O5GKCMJ8.Rationale:
Rationale: Commuters read a result more easily in words, but unsupported generated text would reduce trust and could overclaim savings (BMA risk R8); the explanation may only restate calculated, rule-approved facts and must not calculate emissions, invent weather or override eligibility rules.
MOE: Number of sampled explanations that contain a figure, weather condition or travel mode not present in the calculated result (target 0)
MOE selection: A zero-defect count of unsupported statements directly shows whether the explanation stays inside the calculated result.
Validation: Inspect a random sample of 50 displayed explanations in the pilot build, comparing each field by field with the calculated result; pass if none contains an unsupported figure, condition or mode.
Verification method: Inspection
Source needs: 1.1.8 (BMA N3)

I_TD7E6NBHCP5V7_VY93D4HJMYFJ.name: export approved aggregates at retirement
I_TD7E6NBHCP5V7_VY93D4HJMYFJ.desc: The EcoCommute system shall export the approved aggregate summaries at service retirement.
I_TD7E6NBHCP5V7_VY93D4HJMYFJ.Rationale:
Rationale: Preserves program evidence for the institution without keeping personal data.
MOE: Percentage of approved aggregate summaries exported at retirement (target 100%)
MOE selection: A completeness count shows that the evidence the institution is entitled to survives closure.
Validation: Disposal rehearsal verifies the export file against the approved summary list.
Verification method: Test
Source needs: 1.3.4 (BMA N12)

I_CXNSBMWTDCNW_TD066VE8X02W.name: Stakeholder Requirements
I_CXNSBMWTDCNW_TD066VE8X02W.desc: Stakeholder requirements of the EcoCommute system, each derived from one or more stakeholder needs.

I_GAT0SB098Q6N_3R7TAJTMZZ90.name: avoid device location traces
I_GAT0SB098Q6N_3R7TAJTMZZ90.desc: The EcoCommute system shall not collect location traces from Commuter devices.
I_GAT0SB098Q6N_3R7TAJTMZZ90.Rationale:
Rationale: Passive GPS is excluded from the baseline scope; collecting it would raise cost and privacy exposure.
MOE: Number of device location traces collected (target 0)
MOE selection: A zero count shows directly that the scope boundary is respected.
Validation: Network and storage inspection of the pilot build; pass if no location traces are transmitted or stored.
Verification method: Inspection
Source needs: 1.3.3 (BMA N10)

I_4EYOOP028K482K_HA3DM9NKH5NYM1.name: System-wide Requirements
I_4EYOOP028K482K_HA3DM9NKH5NYM1.desc: Non-functional (system-wide) requirements: cost, schedule, performance, availability, accessibility, privacy and estimation quality.
I_4EYOOP028K482K_HA3DM9NKH5NYM1.Rationale: Rationale: Organizing group for system requirements. Traced to stakeholder requirements 2.1, 2.2, 2.3, 2.4, 2.5.

I_WZUI8A8ZW5CA3C_T6GTF33HRJ2A01.name: utilize reviewed file or source-document ingestion to interface with the Emission Factor Publisher
I_WZUI8A8ZW5CA3C_T6GTF33HRJ2A01.desc: The EcoCommute system shall utilize a reviewed file or source-document ingestion to interface with the Emission Factor Publisher.
I_WZUI8A8ZW5CA3C_T6GTF33HRJ2A01.Rationale:
Rationale: Conduit 'Reviewed factors' is the only path for its information; fixing the medium early lets interface testing start.
MOP: Share of interface exchanges completed through the stated medium (target 100%).
Verification criteria: Exercise the 'Reviewed factors' conduit end to end with a stub of the external party. Method: Test.
Stakeholder requirements: 2.4.1
